disposition: Do not promote any of the three new constructions. Retain current V68 opportunity with V53/V63 batting/value as the research anchor; keep V74 translated-linear hitting as a tested alternative, not an adopted blend. Overall and public value errors worsen under both response measures; prospect-only signed-head gains are uncertain and do not fix workload.
reasonability: All count arithmetic is consistent, but Langford's raw 1760-PA extrapolation and mismatched event mix fail a substantive reasonability check. Signed heads can improve a few value forecasts while leaving contradictory baseline workload. Common-origin scoring includes league-condition changes and is not full WAR. Prospect entry, finite absence, superstar shrinkage, lower-level long-term ability, public MAE, source coverage and calibrated uncertainty remain unresolved.

players.57052: Kurtz has only 50 A/AA PA but a real fresh rank score of .63 and high draft pedigree; the stale display's zero ranking is not what the model received. The direct path adds .188 from rank and .073 from translated HR, lifting value .031 to .190; active value is .655 times the unchanged .0606 arrival probability. Count paths penalize thin exposure despite ranking lifts, yielding 7.26 PA and .513 HR versus 489 PA and 36 HR. Refined support is one full and zero active player. Cam Smith's 493 PA and Quero/Williams zero illustrate uncertain timing without excusing the major thin-elite miss. None of the new constructions solves it.
players.53164: Langford's 200 pro PA, ten HR, 36 walks and .95 fresh rank are present, with 80 AA/AAA PA and .143 translated reliability. Baseline .599 arrival times 358.74 active PA yields 214.92. Separate log-count heads stack positive ranking and AA/Aplus role paths to 1760.24 raw PA, then proportionally cap to 800. Final 275.89 K and 58.83 singles make value -.904, against actual 557 PA, 115 K and +1.796 common/+2.234 relative contribution. The cap preserves accounting but not plausibility. Both refined support intersections are absent. Teel, Montgomery and DeLauter have zero next-year PA; Amador 36. This rejects this fit's extrapolation, not Langford's pedigree or all count modeling.
players.44122: Julio has 340 Aplus/AA PA with 13 HR and 42 walks in 2021; canceled 2020 MiLB is missing, not failure. Fresh rank .98 and earlier .96/.83 enter direct paths positively, moving contribution 1.116 to 1.867. Active 1.645 times .805 gives 1.324. Counts produce only 175.40 PA and 5.88 HR against 560 and 28, leaving value 1.303. Refined full/active support is 10/7. Torkelson 404, Abrams 302, Casas 95 and Davis zero show different timing and production. The direct value gain is real for this case but is not a repaired workload path or proof that every elite prospect should become a full-season star.
players.33263: Alonso's 574 AA/AAA PA, 36 HR and 73 walks survive the join; fresh rank .50 and pooled AAA HR .05985 support positive signed-tree paths. Direct/active values .987/.994 improve on .765 but still miss actual 6.598 common or 5.926 relative. Counts raise PA from 215.03 to 281.66 yet predict just 10.95 HR against 53, reducing value to .647. Refined support is 6/4. Lester, Craig and Hayes have zero next-year PA and Solak 135; their measured profiles are not equal Alonso's AAA exposure or power. The higher-scoring 2019 reference explains .672 of his label, not the remaining major workload and production miss.
players.54849: Judge retains 696/458/704 MLB PA and 62/37/58 HR in the three origin-known seasons. Pooled quality 3.649 and 58 recent HR are present, with 69 full/active refined people, although that does not establish exact superstar support. Direct/active paths recognize quality but predict 5.199/5.355 against baseline 5.668 and actual 9.393. Counts improve expected PA 530.75 to 562.52 but predict only 28.60 HR against 53 and value 4.230. Olson, Schwarber and Ohtani reach 724/724/727 PA, Ozuna 592. The paired outcomes show a meaningful star-tail compression issue, not a missing source row, and more PA does not offset weaker predicted event mix.
players.31364: Maitan is 17 with 176 rookie PA, two HR, ten walks and 49 K. Fresh current rank is .14, not the stale displayed .69, while prior-year rank .69 genuinely remains. Direct value .276 is driven partly by that lagged rank's +.237 path; it is not a forecast of 80 PA or a career talent grade. Current PA is 1.985, count PA .191, active value .004, and actual MLB participation zero. Five full refined people and zero active people limit inference. Guerrero, Infante, Coronado and Mendez also have zero next-year PA. Immediate non-arrival is unsurprising; this short horizon cannot establish whether the model values teenage long-term talent appropriately.
players.34859: Reynolds has 383 AA PA, seven HR, 40 walks and 73 K after 541 Aplus PA. Fresh listing remains absent in this global ranking source; that is not a claim he had no scouting value. Translated probabilities imply 28.4% K and 1.44% HR; active paths subtract for no pooled MLB quality and weak translated HR. Baseline 15.64% times 81.02 active PA gives 12.67; counts only 16.27 and .325 HR against 546 PA and 16 HR. Direct value -.008 is worse than .030. Refined support 634/183 means sparse global count alone cannot explain the failure. Jackson four PA, Nunez 43, Arenado/Woodrow zero are measured controls, not equivalent hidden talent. This is a continuing readiness/representation miss.
players.28820: Lugo has 557 AA PA, 13 HR, 32 walks and 72 K; translated UBB is 3.09% and HR 1.77%. Count means 69.85 PA, .91 HR, 2.49 UBB and 36.17 other outcomes yield -.022 contribution, closer than baseline +.161 to actual -.235, despite PA moving farther from 101. Direct/active remain too positive .174/.181. Full/active refined support is 173/68. Reyes has 219 PA with negative value, Kiner-Falefa 396 and positive value, Espinal/Dubon zero. This is a hitting-mix gain paired with a workload loss, not a complete projection improvement or causal proof about the translated walk feature.
players.47261: Tatis has 257 actual short-2020 MLB PA and 546 in 2021 with 17/42 HR, then zero 2022 MLB PA and 14 AA PA. Origin input on_40man is zero and stage Upper minors despite prior MLB debut; retained talent is not erased. Baseline arrival is only .134, giving 39.68 PA against 635. Direct pooled-quality and age paths lift value .209 to 2.459 without repairing PA; active is 2.729 times .134 = .366, counts 34.70 PA and 1.06 HR. The finite-suspension gap was documented previously and is not an unforeseen departure. Support 11/6 and Sisco/Long/Welker zero, Jones 11 are poor suspended-star analogues. Do not adopt a value gain that conceals the missing availability interpretation.
players.51296: Soto's 654/664/708 prior MLB PA and 122/129/121 unintentional walks are present, with three seasons of 29/27/35 HR. Baseline value 6.126 is lowered by direct/active to 4.534/4.956; counts improve PA 633.93 to 670.16 against 713 but predict only 73.43 UBB and 29.15 HR against 127/41, lowering value to 2.818. The model received translated UBB probability .182, so the deficient final walk mix is a learned forecast, not an omitted walk count. Refined support is 18/18. Guerrero 697 PA, Rutschman 638, Paredes 641 and Acuna 222 show real downside variation but do not make Soto's severe walk regression sensible. This is the largest direct and count value harm.
players.32384: Donaldson's 219 recent MLB PA follows 496 and 700, with 8/33/37 HR; minor rehab counts are explicitly separate, not new prospect experience. Direct and active recognize pooled quality 1.631 and older strong seasons, raising value 2.504 to 3.787/3.673 against 5.976 common or 5.337 relative. The active intermediate is 4.044 times .908. PA remains 430.84 while actual is 659, so the gain is not a return-workload repair. Counts 427.74 PA and 16.12 HR lower value to 2.122. Support 192/165 and Fowler 574, Joyce 238, Cozart 107, Cespedes zero keep downside visible. History-sensitive value helps this recovery but does not guarantee recovery for all older stars.
players.28810: Seager's 687 and 613 MLB PA with 26/22 HR support a reasonable healthy-season expectation, but actual next year delivers only 115 PA and .368 common value. Direct/active pooled-quality, young-age and workload paths lift value from 3.770 to 4.900/5.237, the largest active-head harm. Counts retain 630.83 PA and predict 29.17 HR, also worsening value to 4.245. Full/active support is 82/82, not absence-specific certainty. Machado/Bregman receive 709/705 PA, Bell 583 and Correa 468. Outcome-selected harm must remain, but future low participation alone is not evidence the model should have known the later health outcome or suppressed every young regular's expectation.
players.42360: Judge at the 2021 origin has 633 MLB PA and 39 HR; short-2020 raw 114 PA/9 HR is preserved, with separate workload normalization. Count value improves 3.443 to 5.572, its largest gain, from 535.88 PA and 33.12 HR against actual 696 PA/62 HR. Direct/active produce 3.990/3.833. Workload, translated HR and double-profile paths support power, but no path establishes a causal doubles effect. Refined support is 56/56; Suarez 629 PA, Bryant 181, Story 396 and Soler 306 show downside variation. A large gain on a spectacular season is useful evidence, yet the same count construction underestimates Judge at the 2024 origin and fails overall.
players.24584: Dahl has 237 MLB PA/7 HR plus 400 AA/AAA PA/18 HR in 2016. Count workload paths respond to his brief MLB sample and accumulated games, forecasting 631.78 PA against actual zero, compared with baseline 394.67. Nevertheless count value .229 is closer to zero than baseline 1.671 because its event mixture is weak: 165 K, 28.68 UBB, 22.47 HR and 301.74 other outcomes. This is compensating error, not successful absence prediction. Refined support is 6/6; Sanchez 525 PA, Turner 447, Hernandez 95 and Quinn zero retain the opposite outcomes. It is unreasonable to describe a value-score gain as better playing time or knowledge of the subsequent absence.
players.28502: Knapp has 204 recent MLB PA, three HR, 27 walks and 56 K, after 443 AAA PA. Counts project 215.10 PA against 215 actual, the ordinary workload control, but 62.23 K and 10.32 doubles against 75 and six. That optimistic event mix produces +.538 value versus actual -.227; baseline +.448 is less wrong. Direct +.370 helps modestly, active +.517 hurts. Support is 24/22. Wolters 216, Marisnick 235, Pinder 333 and Valaika 133 demonstrate plausible part-time workloads with differing production. Exact PA is not exact value, and no catcher defense or position benefit is included in this batting-only target.
